newsitem.title: USA: Schroder Wertheim names head of fixed income.
newsitem.headline: Schroder Wertheim names head of fixed income.

text.p: Schroder Wertheim & Co Inc, a unit of Schroder Plc, said it named Mark Field, formerly of Salomon Brothers, to head its fixed income department.

Field headed the high yield department at Salomon Brothers, a unit of Salomon Inc. During his career there, he held various positions in fixed income sales and product management, including high yield and investment grade.
"I look forward to working with my new colleagues at Schroder Wertheim to grow the value added non-commodity sectors of the business," Field said in a statement.
